RAZORPAY.label: Razorpay
RAZORPAY.desc: Cards, UPI, net banking and wallets. Payment links for the billing counter and checkout in the patient portal.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.hint: The secret you typed when adding the webhook in the Razorpay dashboard.

ABDM.label: ABDM gateway
ABDM.desc: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission: ABHA creation and verification, and linking care contexts as a HIP.

MESSAGING.label: Delivery reports
MESSAGING.desc: Receives delivery and read receipts from the SMS and WhatsApp providers.

metaVerifyToken.label: Meta webhook verify token
metaVerifyToken.hint: Any long random text; type the same in the Meta app’s webhook setup.

PACS.label: PACS (Orthanc)
PACS.desc: Studies from the CT, X-ray, MRI and ultrasound machines arrive in the worklist on their own, and the machines pick the patient from a modality worklist.

baseUrl.label: Orthanc REST URL
baseUrl.hint: The HTTPS address of Orthanc’s REST API (port 8042 behind TLS). Never the DICOM port.

username.label: Orthanc user name
username.hint: A user from Orthanc’s RegisteredUsers. Leave blank when you use a token.

connection.label: How HMS hears of new studies

modalities.label: Modalities it serves
modalities.hint: Blank: all. Comma-separated HMS modalities, e.g. CT, XR, MRI.

stationAets.label: Scheduled station AE title per modality
stationAets.hint: The AE title of each machine, so it lists only its own patients. Comma-separated MODALITY=AE.

dicomModalityCodes.label: DICOM modality code per modality (optional)
dicomModalityCodes.hint: Overrides the defaults (X-ray DX, ultrasound US, MRI MR, mammography MG…).

password.label: Orthanc password
password.hint: Stored encrypted. Use a long random password, never Orthanc’s default.

apiToken.label: Bearer token (instead of a password)
apiToken.hint: For an Orthanc behind an authenticating proxy or the authorization plugin.

hookSecret.label: Push signing secret
hookSecret.hint: Generate it below; the Orthanc plugin signs every push with it.

bits.secretSaved: Saved (ends {{last4}}). Leave blank to keep it.
bits.copyNow: Copy it now. It is stored only as a hash (or encrypted) and will not be shown again.
bits.liveWarning: Live mode uses real money / real patient data. Test in sandbox first.

abha.title: ABHA — Ayushman Bharat Health Account
abha.flowIntro: {{flow}}. ABDM sends a one-time code to the patient.
abha.consent: The patient agrees to create an ABHA using their Aadhaar, and to share their Aadhaar details with ABDM for it.
abha.mobileForAbhaHint: Best the one linked to Aadhaar.

billOnline.linkSent: Payment link made and sent to the patient.
billOnline.linkMade: Payment link made — copy it to the patient.
billOnline.title: Online payment

abdm.title: ABDM
abdm.subtitle: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission: create and verify ABHA at registration, and link records to the patient’s ABHA as a health information provider (HIP).
abdm.apiWarning: ABDM changes its APIs from time to time. This connector is built on the v3 sandbox contract; test every flow in sandbox before switching to live, and keep the facility’s HIP and HFR registration current.
abdm.callbackHint: ABDM sends link tokens and link results here. Register it once per client id.
abdm.abhaSubtitle: Front desk: Register patient › Create or verify ABHA (permission “Create ABHA”). Aadhaar numbers and OTPs are encrypted for ABDM and never stored or logged.
abdm.switchOnToUse: Switch ABDM on to use it.
abdm.ccSubtitle: Preview: asks ABDM for a link token for the patient, then links the visits you list when ABDM calls back.
abdm.sent: Sent to ABDM. The result arrives on the callback.
abdm.platformNotReady: ABDM isn’t connected on the platform yet. Your software provider sets up the ABDM account; until then this hospital can save its facility details but not switch ABDM on.
abdm.viaPlatformSandbox: Connected through the platform’s ABDM account (sandbox).
abdm.viaPlatformLive: Connected through the platform’s ABDM account (live).

logs.title: Integration logs
logs.subtitle: Every call to and from payment, messaging and ABDM providers, devices and webhooks — with what went wrong.
logs.redactedNote: Outlines are redacted: no secrets, keys, OTPs, Aadhaar numbers or result values are ever written here. Entries are deleted after {{days}} days.
logs.emptyHint: Calls appear here once a provider, device or webhook is in use.

messaging.msg91Subtitle: MSG91 posts delivery reports to this address. Add it in MSG91 › Settings › Delivery report webhook.
messaging.reportUrlHint: The random part of the address is the password — keep it private.
messaging.waSubtitle: Meta sends sent / delivered / read / failed for every message. Meta app › WhatsApp › Configuration › Webhook.
messaging.subscribeNote: Subscribe the webhook to the messages field. Every call is checked against the app secret (X-Hub-Signature-256); calls that don’t match are refused and logged.
messaging.notCloudApi: WhatsApp isn’t sent with the Cloud API
messaging.title: SMS & WhatsApp
messaging.subtitle: How patient messages are sent — MSG91 or any SMS gateway, the WhatsApp Cloud API, SMTP email — and what the providers report back.
messaging.sameSettings: The same settings as Administration › <link>Notification rules</link> › Delivery. What each event says, and the {{sms}} DLT template ids, are set there.

payments.webhookHint: Razorpay dashboard › Settings › Webhooks › Add: paste this URL, type a secret (save the same secret above) and tick the events below.
payments.setupNote: Billing makes a payment link for a bill’s balance (bill › Payment link); the patient portal shows a Pay button on bills when “Bills and receipts” is on. A captured payment becomes one receipt on the bill, made by the gateway — never twice, even when Razorpay repeats a webhook.
payments.refundNote: This returns money at Razorpay only. Record the refund or credit note on the bill in Billing too, so the books and the bill agree.
payments.search: Bill, patient, order or payment id…
payments.emptyHint: Payment links from Billing and payments from the patient portal appear here.
payments.notReceipted: Paid at the gateway but not receipted.
payments.reviewHint: Check the bill; then either “Check with gateway” to receipt it, or refund.
payments.title: Payment gateway
payments.subtitle: Collect bills online — payment links from the counter and Pay in the patient portal — receipted automatically.

devices.overHttpNote: {{protocol}} over HTTP: most analyzers talk serial / TCP, so a small middleware (or the vendor’s LIS bridge) forwards each message to the endpoint.
devices.mappingHint: Codes without a row here are matched to a parameter with the same code on a test of that sample.
devices.disabled: Device disabled — its key is refused until you enable it.
devices.removeMsg: Its key stops working at once. Results and punches it sent stay.
devices.newKeyMsg: The current key stops working at once. Put the new key in the device or middleware straight away.
devices.title: Devices & analyzers
devices.subtitle: Lab analyzers and biometric attendance devices that send data straight in — each with its own key.
devices.emptyHint: Add an analyzer or a biometric device to get its key.
devices.endpointHint: POST with the header X-Device-Key: <the device key>. Up to 240 calls a minute; batch where you can.
devices.csvColsBiometric: Columns: EmpCode, DateTime (or Date + Time), Direction.
devices.hl7Note: ORU^R01: barcode from SPM-2 or OBR-3/OBR-2, code from OBX-3, value from OBX-5. The answer is an HL7 ACK.
devices.astmNote: ASTM E1394 records: barcode from O-3, code from R-3 (^^^code), value from R-4.
devices.labNote: Results come in as entered, not verified — a technologist verifies them in Lab › Verify (unless the lab’s auto-verify-normal setting is on). The sample must be received in the lab first.
devices.biometricNote: Punches are matched by employee code; the same punch sent twice is kept once. Attendance for those days is recalculated.
devices.putKey: Put it in the device or its middleware as the X-Device-Key header.

PULL.label: Pull — HMS checks Orthanc for new studies
PULL.hint: Orthanc is reachable from the internet over HTTPS (cloud-hosted, published through a TLS proxy or tunnel, or over a VPN).

PUSH.label: Push — Orthanc tells HMS of each new study
PUSH.hint: Orthanc is behind the hospital’s NAT. A small plugin on Orthanc posts each stable study to HMS, signed.

mwlMode.OFF: Off — technicians type the patient on the machine
mwlMode.ON_ORDER: As soon as the study is ordered

pacs.sandboxNote: Sandbox allows an http:// Orthanc for a test bench. Use Live — https only — for real patients.
pacs.noRestUrl: Without a REST URL HMS still files each pushed study and matches it, but cannot open its images or send worklist items itself. Forward the studies to a cloud Orthanc (setup step 6) and enter its URL to see images here.
pacs.noWorklistRest: Orthanc has no worklist REST API: use the file-based helper (setup step 5).
pacs.shownToTechs: Shown to technicians (where the machines send)
pacs.newSecretMsg: The Orthanc plugin stops being accepted until you put the new secret in its .env file and restart it.
pacs.pushSubtitle: For an Orthanc behind the hospital’s NAT: its plugin posts each stable study here, signed with the push secret (HMAC-SHA256, 5-minute window). The worklist address serves the file-based worklist helper.
pacs.pushAddressHint: The random part identifies this hospital; every call must also be signed.
pacs.worklistAddressHint: Only for the file-based worklist (push mode or Orthanc older than 1.12.9).
pacs.putSecret: Put it in the Orthanc PC’s .env file as HMS_PACS_HOOK_SECRET and restart Orthanc.
pacs.statusSubtitle: What the link has done. Every call to Orthanc that fails is in Integration logs (provider PACS).
pacs.notAvailable: Not available — use the file-based helper
pacs.matchUnder: Match studies under <link>Radiology › Worklist › Unmatched studies</link>.
pacs.guideSubtitle: One Orthanc per hospital. The machines send to it on the LAN; HMS reaches it over HTTPS, or it reaches HMS.
pacs.guideWarning: Never expose DICOM port 4242 to the internet, never keep Orthanc’s default password, and publish the REST API only over HTTPS (or not at all, in push mode).
pacs.title: PACS
pacs.subtitle: Link the hospital’s Orthanc: studies from the CT, X-ray, MRI and ultrasound machines reach the radiology worklist and open in the viewer, and the machines pick patients from the worklist.
pacs.privateNetwork: This server may connect to private network addresses for the PACS (PACS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK). Use that only where HMS runs inside the hospital or over a VPN.
